ratio: native input cost / xnip input cost on the same task; xnip = 1x
aggregation: exp(mean(log(per-task ratio))); each task has equal weight; repetitions are not independent tasks
all_cases_scope: payload ratio only, including byte-incompatible native outputs
returned_text_scope: captured text boundary only; aider final model message unknown, never zero-filled
combined_scope: sum of independently counted input and captured returned text; excludes schemas, repair requests, host framing and complete agent workflow
exact_pairs_scope: both tools byte-exact in every repetition; subsets differ between backends

frontier.selection_scope: best observed among supplied profiles that are byte-exact in every recorded repetition; not a global optimum or an executed strategy
frontier.contract_scope: guarded pools accept guarded profiles only; snapshot-enabled pools accept guarded and snapshot profiles on both sides; winning profiles retain their actual contract; xnip MCP and CLI transports never share a minimum
frontier.native_transport_scope: native executor-input minima may span native transports; each winning profile retains its transport
frontier.aggregation: equal-task geometric means of native best / xnip best within the same candidate-permission pool and xnip transport
frontier.returned_text_scope: known captured text only; aider final returned text is always unknown
frontier.serialized_mcp_scope: independently counted canonical serialized full JSON-RPC reply when recorded; unknown for other products and historical rows; not host/provider usage
frontier.invocation_scope: CLI invocation arguments and serialized tool-request envelopes remain separate; neither is added to executor input; schema/setup costs are excluded

receipt_modes.scope: canonical serialized full JSON-RPC reply only, structured versus text receipt mode; not provider billing or complete agent usage
receipt_modes.ratio: text receipt full reply / structured receipt full reply on the same task and strategy
receipt_modes.qualification: both profiles byte-exact in every recorded repetition, both full-reply costs captured, and actual captured input and returned-text sequences identical; missing calls or different content exclude the effect ratio and savings
receipt_modes.aggregation: equal task/profile-pair geometric mean; sums include the same qualified pairs; repeats are not extra votes
receipt_modes.equality_scope: cost equality and actual captured-string equality are separate; absent calls or costs remain unknown
